rationale_summary: With 12 current medals and only three unscored tasks, even three additional medals yield 15, so at least three existing nonmedals must convert. The evidence-based path is jigsaw first, then stretch attempts on spooky and taxi; SIIM, TPS May 2022, aerial cactus, and leaf are bounded reserves because their official bronze gaps or exact-perfect threshold make conversion low-probability.
